title: Mi Flora plant sensor
summary: Soil and light readings for individual plants.
body:
## Place and discover

Install the sensor as instructed by its manufacturer and provide Bluetooth coverage with a proxy. Set up the Xiaomi BLE integration (xiaomi_ble) in Home Assistant.

## Check each plant

Confirm soil moisture, conductivity, light and temperature update before assigning the plant. Choose suitable thresholds for the plant and substrate. Ramka can display a plant page when configured; this sensor does not provide automatic watering.

## Setup references

- [Xiaomi BLE setup — Home Assistant](https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/xiaomi_ble/)

These upstream instructions may evolve; the component versions and pinned source above record the DomoSenso scope.
